issues: identity_check always returns to identity, even after establishing deceased, unclear, declined, or no_callback. Entering a conversation node does not guarantee immediate reevaluation of its transitions. This can ask another question after a deceased report or delay an established closing outcome until another customer turn.

Answers to assistance questions are not distinguished from security or payment consent. For example, during payment confirmation, a human request produces 'May I help you first?' without changing the confirmation phase; the next yes can authorize create_promise. A failed transfer's 'continue helping here' question has the same problem. Before verification, an assistance yes can also be mistaken for name confirmation.

Identity refusals are counted separately from statements that the customer does not want to talk. During security, an identity refusal followed by a refusal to talk can incorrectly receive another explanation instead of closing not_verified/declined.

An unclear corrected amount or an unparseable corrected date can leave collection_phase=confirm. A subsequent yes to a clarification question can therefore authorize the previous terms without a new complete read-back.

The full_too_much and below-floor branches discard a simultaneously proposed payment date. After accepting the floor, the customer can receive a read-back using the previous date. Repeated rejection of the floor through full_too_much also asks another acceptance question instead of applying the refusal rules.

The weekend and Friday-holiday persuasion fallback invents a bank rule. A30 moves attempt one to the following week only when today is the current week's last business day. When that day is already past, A19 prohibits the calculated date, but the supplied policy does not authorize substituting next week's date or the deadline.

schedule_callback failure is automatically closed as not_reached/no_callback. The supplied brief does not assign that closing outcome to a callback service failure; A7 establishes it after the permitted invalid-window handling. The failure must remain truthful without inventing an outcome.

New hardship accompanying an unqualified acceptance can bypass the support offer and authorize an earlier payment read-back even though the customer supplied no voluntary date or amount with the hardship.
